summary: Backend testing for Multi-WhatsApp Numbers feature. All 20 tests passed. Verified: CRUD operations for WhatsApp contacts, E.164 phone validation, settings management, public endpoint for buyer flow, and primary contact switching logic.
critical_code_review_comments: The WhatsApp feature is implemented as an extension layer that does NOT modify the existing inquiry system - this is a good architectural choice.
Phone number validation uses E.164 format validation correctly (+919876543210)
Only one contact can be primary at a time - switching primary correctly unsets other contacts
Public endpoint GET /api/seller/whatsapp/seller/{id}/primary is properly implemented for buyer flow after inquiry submission
seed_data_creation: Test contacts created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: WhatsApp contacts feature fully functional. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_seller_whatsapp_contacts.py. Features tested: GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE contacts, set-primary, get/update settings, public seller primary endpoint. Inquiry response includes whatsapp field when seller has WhatsApp contacts configured.

api_endpoints_verified.GET /api/seller/whatsapp/seller/{seller_: Public endpoint for buyer flow (no auth)
